name: Chomp: one enormous bite
objective: Explore a large Chomp pre-steal attack number under fixed conditions, comparing legal item swaps rather than assuming a global maximum.
mechanic: Rank-5 Q replaces one attack with 90 + 1.55 total AD physical damage. Bloodthirster and Sterak's observed base-AD conversion raise the attack coefficient; Hubris adds earned temporary AD; Serylda and flat lethality compete against the fixed armor. Profane is an AD/lethality slot, not an extra Q multiplier. Spellblade and critical delivery are separate experiments, not silently folded into this noncritical bite.
finiteState: Level 18, maximum target rank, game time 30 minutes, no elixir, dragons or allied buffs. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 900 current HP, 100 armor and 50 MR before any explicitly tested debuff. Owner starts at full HP. No free permanent stacks. One Q with no previous Chomp AD buff. Hubris has exactly 10 credited kills and its 90-second buff active. No R armor theft. Gathering Storm at 30 minutes; Absolute Focus active. Record raw potential separately from effective damage; do not count packets after the target dies.
test: Record pre-hit total AD, then one noncritical Q. Do not add the 40 AD stolen after this hit back into it. Compare Sterak against Edge of Night and compare Profane against Trinity Force: report Trinity's Spellblade separately as well as the combined attack. Repeat at 50 and 200 armor with the same earned Hubris state.
limits: No ordinary-attack crit multiplier assumed for the full Q packet. Hubris buff, Sterak conversion, penetration and all item proc damage need in-game readback; current partial adapters do not include every passive.
tradeoff: A melee damage loadout without boots or durable access can lose before the bite lands; the six-item number is not a lane build order.
